title: Latitude and Longitude Finder: Coordinates
description: Find the latitude and longitude of any place with the Latitude and Longitude Finder — search or click, read the pair, copy it anywhere. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, searching 'Eiffel Tower' returns 48.8584, 2.2945 — the pair every other tool on this site is waiting to consume.
quick_answer: The Latitude and Longitude Finder gives the latitude and longitude of any place you search for or click on the map. Find the place and read its coordinate pair — the starting point for converters, distance tools, datasets and every 'where exactly is it?' question that follows.

faq: What does this tool find?
The WGS84 latitude/longitude of a searched place or a clicked point — the pair itself, presented copy-ready.
Do I need an account?
No — search or click, read the pair.
Can I use the result for professional work?

As coordinates sourced from open place data, yes for the usual run of work — with the standing note that legal positions come from surveys, and address-grade work can use the address tools' refinement.
Which datum do these coordinate tools use?
WGS84 — the frame GPS produces and web maps consume.
Do more decimal places always mean better accuracy?
No — resolution is not accuracy; the precision tools on this site price each decimal place in metres.
How precise is the pair?
To the record's point — landmarks to their mapped position, clicks to the pixel's ground. Display decimals follow the precision family's honesty rules.
It found the wrong place with my name.
Place names repeat worldwide — add the town, region or country to the search, or click the map directly.
My own location?
Find My Location is the dedicated page for the device's fix.
Coordinates of a photo?
EXIF pairs paste into the Coordinates Lookup Tool; this finder works forward from names and clicks.
Ocean features?
Islands and named sea features resolve where the data names them; open water has clicks, not searches.
Batch of places?
One at a time here — the Batch Geocoder exists for lists.
